Completed onboarding with Anna. She had minimal questions throughout the training. One of her main questions was regarding what an ITIN number is, and I explained that it is a tax identification number used for customers who do not have legal status or a Social Security number. I also emphasized the importance of verifying that these customers provide a valid Texas-issued or government-issued ID.

Overall, Anna demonstrated a clear understanding of the process. I highlighted the importance of marking invoices as tax exempt, explaining that EasyPay collects taxes directly from the customer so the shop does not have to. I also stressed the importance of verifying IDs and ensuring that all transactions are completed in person.

Anna mentioned that the process seemed very easy and straightforward. I made sure to provide her with my contact information in case any questions or concerns arise. She also mentioned that she may be submitting or finalizing her first application today.
